**How we found your details, and how we look after them**

**Who we are.** {company_name}, {company_address}. Contact: {reply_email}.

**What we hold.** Your name and address as the registered owner of land {site_description}, and anything you choose to tell us if you reply.

**Where it came from.** HM Land Registry's public register of title.

**Why we use it.** To write to you about the possible development potential of your land. Our legal basis is legitimate interests: we have a genuine business reason to contact landowners, and we keep the contact limited and respectful. We have recorded our reasoning in a written assessment, which you can ask to see.

**Who we share it with.** No one, except the professional advisers who help us (for example a planning consultant or solicitor), and only if you decide to talk to us. We never sell your details.

**How long we keep it.** If you do not reply, for up to 12 months, then we delete it. If you tell us not to contact you, we keep only your name and address on a do-not-contact list, so we never write again.

**Your rights.** You can ask to see what we hold, have it corrected or deleted, or object to us using it. Contact us at {reply_email}. If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk, 0303 123 1113).
